'''Durik Vesh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. He tried to discover the secrets of the [[Nightmare Lands]] but went mad and was later captured by [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. Discovering Durik's capture, the Empire sent an agent to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him before he could recover and tell the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] everything he knew. The agent succeeded in his mission, and Durik was eliminated.<ref name="Bait" />
